title: feat(service-settings, spec): a settings page serves the value its runtime has in use, so the built-in AI provider and its source are readable
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9TtvF5DfA1WBDgFgsfFNoFR)_
Fixes #32052

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：设置页读取 `GET /api/settings/:namespace` 多了一个可选的 `live` 字段，由真正做决定的运行时（AI 是 service-ai）声明「当前实际在用的值和来源」，例如 `live.provider = { value: 'openai', source: 'environment' }`；spec 的 `SettingsNamespacePayloadSchema` 同步加了这个可选字段。
- 为什么改：自 #32010 起 `values.provider` 为 null 只代表「设置里没存」，而 AI 仍可能靠环境变量自动识别在跑；首次使用清单（#32021）需要一个能如实判断「内置 AI 配好没有」的只读答案。
- 风险与回滚：只加不改，没有注册运行时（本仓单独构建时就是这样）或只给横幅的页面，响应逐字节不变；值只能是该键自己的选项之一、只回 `value` 与 `source`，密钥进不来。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.ts`（`liveStatementOf` / `servedLiveValues` / `judgeLiveValue`）、`settings-routes.ts` 读路由、`packages/spec/src/system/settings-manifest.zod.ts` 的 `live`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run src/settings-routes.live-status.pin.test.ts`，应见 22 个测试全绿，其中带 ⛔ 的几条断言响应体里不含密钥、无权限调用方 403 且运行时从未被询问。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（spec 已发布 schema 有改动，席位按 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 出复审记录）。

## What changes

- **Seam (service-settings).** `SettingsLiveStatus` (the answer a package gives through the existing `registerLiveStatus(namespace, provider)`) gains an optional `values` (a record of KEY to `SettingsLiveValue`); `SettingsLiveValue = { value: string | null; source: 'settings' | 'environment' | 'none' }`. The provider is still asked once per page read and never cached.
- **Door.** The existing page read `GET /api/settings/:namespace`, no new route. It serves the stated values as an optional top-level `live` field beside `values`. It is computed after `getNamespace`, so it sits behind the page's own read gate (`readPermission`; `manage_platform_settings` for `ai`); a refused caller never reaches the provider.
- **No secret by construction.** A served entry is rebuilt from `value` and `source` alone; anything else the runtime attaches is dropped. The key must be a declared option-bearing key of the namespace, and a non-null value must be one its option table admits (the declared `options`, or a registered option source's answer), so a served value is always one of the page's own options. `value` is `null` exactly when `source` is `'none'`.
- **An invalid entry drops only itself** (seat ruling on step 0): the key reads as not stated, the banner the runtime stated and the other entries stand, and the server logs one warn per read naming the key and why, never the value. Only a provider throw becomes the "Live status unavailable" error banner, and then no `live` is served.
- **Unknown vs none.** No provider registered (every build of this repo alone, no service-ai), a banner-only statement, or a key not named ⇒ `live` / `live.KEY` absent = not stated (unknown). `{ value: null, source: 'none' }` only when the runtime states it. service-settings cannot tell "no AI runtime" from "a runtime that does not state its provider yet", so without service-ai the honest answer is unknown.
- **A statement whose `values` cannot be read** (a throwing accessor) is handled inside the provider guard: the error banner, no `live`, never a `500` (review N4). Each entry is read once and judged into the served `{ value, source }` pair (review N1).
- **One provider call, two halves.** New `SettingsService.liveStatementOf(ns, ctx, display)` returns `{ banner?, live? }`; `liveStatusOf` keeps its signature and returns the banner half.
- **Spec.** `SettingsNamespacePayloadSchema` gains optional `live` (inline schema, no new export). It enters the authorable surface as `system/SettingsNamespacePayload:live`, so `Metadata-protocol: added` and the `@objectstack/spec` changeset is `minor` (review M1); `@objectstack/service-settings` stays `patch`. Regenerated: the settings-manifest reference page, `authorable-surface/system.json` (one row) and the `system/` strictness count (401 → 402, the new inline object site).
- **Served answers that change: none.** A namespace with no live-status provider, or one stating only a banner, answers byte-identically (pinned).

### Census: env auto-detect providers vs the `ai.provider` option table

service-ai auto-detects four providers from its boot environment (`AI_GATEWAY_MODEL` → `gateway`, `OPENAI_API_KEY` → `openai`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` → `anthropic`, `GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY` → `google`; `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` names them). All four are in the declared `ai.provider` table (`packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/ai.manifest.ts`, lines 51-54 at this head): 4 of 4. So every env-detected provider is servable as `live.provider`.

### Carried to repo:cloud

`@objectstack/service-ai`, in the `settings.registerLiveStatus('ai', …)` call the #31960 carry already asks for (cloud mailbox #31366 comment 6756738412), fills `values.provider` from its own provider decision:

- a provider chosen from saved or `OS_*`-locked AI settings ⇒ `{ value: PROVIDER_ID, source: 'settings' }`;
- a provider it auto-detected from its boot environment ⇒ `{ value: PROVIDER_ID, source: 'environment' }`;
- AI disabled, including a memory or echo fallback ⇒ `{ value: null, source: 'none' }`, never `'memory'` (not an option, so it would be dropped and read as not stated).

`PROVIDER_ID` is the `ai.provider` option value (an OpenAI-compatible preset such as `deepseek` is stated as itself, not as `openai`). Never a key, key prefix or base URL. Until service-ai ships this, `live` stays absent and the console reads "unknown".

## Tests

- `settings-routes.live-status.pin.test.ts` gains a top-level `describe` (the shared live-status harness; its `rig()` now takes the manifest and the caller): served value + source with the banner, spec-valid; absent with no provider and with a banner-only statement; `none` only as stated; ⛔ extra fields (a key, a key prefix) never served; ⛔ a credential as the value dropped, banner kept, one warn without the value; eight invalid-entry cases each dropped with the banner kept; a valid entry beside an invalid one (only the invalid one dropped); a provider throw serves no `live`; a throwing `values` accessor answers the error banner, not a `500` (red before the fix: `expected 500 to be 200`); ⛔ a caller without `manage_platform_settings` gets `403 SETTINGS_FORBIDDEN` and the provider is never called.
- `packages/spec/src/system/settings-manifest.test.ts`: `live` accepted (a value, `none`, absent) and a source outside the closed set refused at `live.provider.source`.
- **Forced test edits (3, declared):** the route doubles in `settings-routes.anonymous-floor.pin.test.ts`, `settings-routes.auth-gate.pin.test.ts` and `settings-routes.authz-outage-relay.test.ts` stubbed `liveStatusOf: async () => undefined`; the read route now calls `liveStatementOf`, so each stub is renamed to `liveStatementOf: async () => ({})`. Same meaning: nothing to state.

## Acceptance notes

- The ai.provider gate is the page's own `readPermission`; no second permission was coined.
- New public names, ruled by the seat at step 0: `SettingsLiveStatus.values`, the served `live` field, type `SettingsLiveValue`, method `SettingsService.liveStatementOf`.
- No `ui/**` and no `translations/**` edit; #32021 owns the console step.

## Verification

Head `0190f5a2` (review round 1 on top of `047e94d6`, which merged `origin/main` `fcb2122d`). Base at claim `6fb0eae3`.

<details><summary>Review round 1 (contract review 6759409809: M1, N4, N1)</summary>

- M1: changeset `@objectstack/spec` patch → minor, `Metadata-protocol: none` → `added` (changeset and this body); `packages/spec/authorable-surface/**` untouched in this round. `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main` against this body: exit 0 (level axis: `@objectstack/spec: minor` accounts for the widening).
- N4 red first: the new pin against the round-0 `settings-service.ts` fails `expected 500 to be 200` (1 failed / 22); green after.
- At `0190f5a2`: `vitest run src/settings-routes` 10 files, `Tests 199 passed (199)`; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings typecheck` exit 0.
- Ablations re-run on the restructured code (each restored, blob == HEAD): A1 whole entry served → 1 red; A2 option admission off → 2 red; A5 warn echoes the entry → 3 red.
</details>

<details><summary>Red on main (6fb0eae3): 10 new pins fail before the fix</summary>

`vitest run src/settings-routes.live-status.pin.test.ts` at `6fb0eae3` with only the new pins applied: `Tests 10 failed | 7 passed (17)`. Every `live` pin red (no `live` served); the gate pin was already green (the gate predates this card) and is ablation-verified below.
</details>

<details><summary>Tests at the final head</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings test` (at `9041305c` + the auth-gate double rename): `Test Files 75 passed (75)`, `Tests 1456 passed (1456)`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- At `047e94d6`: `vitest run src/settings-routes` (10 route files): `Tests 198 passed (198)`; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/system/settings-manifest.test.ts`: `Tests 86 passed (86)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
- Lint: `eslint packages/services/service-settings packages/spec/src/system --no-inline-config`: exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

Via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, test `src/settings-routes.live-status.pin.test.ts` (imports source, no dist leg):

- A1 serve the runtime's whole entry (`served[key] = entry`): red, "⛔ serves only the value and its source" (1 failed / 21).
- A2 drop the option-table admission (`|| table.judge(value) !== null` → `|| false`): red, "⛔ leaves out a value that is not one of the key's options" + "serves the valid entry and drops only the invalid one" (2 failed). First attempt refused as a no-op by the tool (replacement already present 3×), re-run with a distinct replacement.
- A3 delete the option-table requirement: red, "a key with no option table, even as none" (1 failed).
- A4 disable the closed source set: red, "a source outside the closed set" (1 failed).
- A5 echo the entry in the warn: red, three secret pins (3 failed).
- A6 ask the provider before the gate (`liveStatementOf` ahead of `getNamespace`): red, including "⛔ is behind the page's own gate … the runtime is never asked" (12 failed).
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 116 commands, all run at `4037fdc3`; 114 exit 0 first pass, `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (no full build), both exit 0 after `pnpm build` under the lock. `--ran`: 116 derived, 116 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. At `047e94d6` the derivation is byte-identical (same 14 paths); spec moved on main by one test file only, so `check:generated` was re-run there (green).
</details>
